items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: That's Willie Pazio. No. ... That's Landry rather. This is Willie Pazio.

ctx.x: Oh yes, this was after depression. Now, you see, this is Pritchett. On the extreme right standing. This is Professor Dalmers. That's the bass player. Bass drum. That's the one that didn't show up on this job and caused me to switch the bass. He's the bass. Now that's Willie Pazio. No.
Yeah. That's Landry. I mean Landry.

items.title: Joseph "Red" Clark Interview, 1959-11-11
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Patio took the picture... That's right, he suicided. [INTERVIEWEE] He did?

ctx.x: So it was somewhere in the 30s there, right? That's right. Well we'll check the date on that fair, we'll be able to find it.
And Patio took the picture, P-A-D-D-I-O, I guess. That's right, he suicided.
